branch_authority_before_event: OVERLORD remains 6 Jun, five beaches, historical-class first wave; direct assault capability index 100-103, D+1-7 follow-up 97-102, later logistics buffer thinner than history.
result: 6 Jun: OVERLORD/NEPTUNE launches on Utah, Omaha, Gold, Juno and Sword. The branch does not contain a pre-D-Day shock large enough to cancel or shrink the assault.
Initial lodgments succeed. Omaha remains the hardest US beach; naval gunfire/airborne/amphibious mechanics remain historical-class rather than being re-rolled from Japanese branch differences.
By 10 Jun a continuous Allied lodgment is operationally established, but high-capacity port access remains unresolved and the branch thinner logistics buffer has not yet crossed a crisis threshold.
Italy: Do not inherit the historical 4 Jun Rome capture. The branch Italy clock is delayed; Rome remains not-credited-as-captured through 10 Jun pending the branch mid/late-June gate.
ANVIL: Remains a provisional mid-July operation with its June final gate still open; no 6-10 Jun cancellation.
global_effect_before_11Jun: No Europe event in this five-day window materially changes the already-committed Pacific FORAGER force.
